alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 12 at 10:37AM PST until November 13 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected. Inundation of 2 to 2.5
feet above ground level is possible along shorelines and low-
lying coastal areas.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Washington.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to noon PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding due to tidal overflow is
expected around high tide. This may lead to flooding of parking
lots, parks, and roads, with only isolated road closures
expected.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 12 at 12:40PM PST until November 13 at 10:00PM PST by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* CHANGES...None.

* WHAT...South to southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55
mph. Wind prone areas along US-395/I-580 may see gusts up to 65
mph.

* WHERE...In California, Lassen-Eastern Plumas-Eastern Sierra
Counties. In Nevada, Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 10 PM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may knock down burned trees in the Davis
Fire, Hawk Fire, and Bull Fire burn areas.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 12 at 10:02AM PST until November 14 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Death Valley National Park and Western Mojave Desert.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Friday to 10 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
